text:
devon_support: Escalating KelpCare onboarding — embedding ingest jobs keep failing for their pilot tenant since last night. Ticket #KELP-4321. P1 for trial activation :warning:

maria_csm: Ugh, thanks for flagging. Quick ask: can you paste the last error and which runner is failing?

devon_support: Logs show repeated timeouts from `embed-runner-3` and `embed-queue` backpressure. Sample: ```ERROR 2025-06-09T23:12:07Z embed-runner-3 timeout: context deadline exceeded RequestID=req-0a1b2c```

ashley_onboarding: KelpCare is mid-onboarding — they have a renewal in 3 months and this is blocking their first production import. Marking renewal risk.

sam_engineering: Looking. Preliminary: increased tail latency on node g3 due to a stuck KV cache flush. Working on a restart plan for runner-3, will try soft-restart first. ETA 20m.

maria_csm: Comms plan proposal: 1) Create dedicated #cs-kelpcare-escalation channel and invite KelpCare AM + eng lead. 2) Offer a targeted enablement session tomorrow to re-run ingest. 3) Apply 2-day provisional credit if we can't clear in 24h. Agree?

devon_support: +1 on channel. Sent DM to client AM to prep. I'll open the channel once we have confirm from eng.

sam_engineering: Soft-restart done on runner-3 at 23:32Z, tail latency improving. Monitoring ingest queue.

alerts-bot: [incident] increased error rate on embedding pipeline for tenant kelpcare detected at 2025-06-09T23:10:00Z — alert ID a1b2c3

ashley_onboarding: I'll draft an email for the AM to send if we need to ask the customer to pause bulk imports for 2 hours. Maria, want to own the enablement session?

maria_csm: I can lead the enablement. I'll prepare a checklist: permission scopes, batch size recommendations, retry/backoff guidance, and a sample `curl` snippet.

devon_support: Client reports one successful batch after restart but some older jobs still failing with 500s. Ticket updated with logs.

sam_engineering: Noted. We're rolling a hotfix to improve KV eviction on runner-3 in next 40m; will fallback to runner-1/2 for routing in the meantime.

maria_csm: OK — next steps: 1) create #cs-kelpcare-escalation (devon to create), 2) sam to post ETA and final fix, 3) I schedule enablement tomorrow 10am PT, 4) record renewal owner @ashley_onboarding + confirm credit policy with finance.

devon_support: Channel created: #cs-kelpcare-escalation — invited client AM (kelp-am), ashley_onboarding, sam_engineering, maria_csm.

alerts-bot: [update] error rate returning to baseline at 2025-06-09T23:47:00Z — alert a1b2c3 resolved

ashley_onboarding: Noted recovery. I'll follow up with AM to confirm whether they want the enablement or to retry on their side. Will keep renewal flagged until we get stable ingest for 48h.

maria_csm: Thanks team. I'll prepare the enablement slide deck + sample runbook and post to the new channel. Closing escalation here but keeping channel open for 48h monitoring. :thumbsup:
